tasks.title: AIRSPEED_MIN from the stall speed
tasks.statement: A QuadPlane with a mass of **{m} kg**, a wing area of **{s} m²**, C_Lmax = **{cl}**, ρ = 1.225 kg/m³. Find the minimum allowed `AIRSPEED_MIN` by the 1.2 · V_s rule, in m/s.
tasks.solution: V_s = √(2·m·g / (ρ·S·C_Lmax)), then `AIRSPEED_MIN` = 1.2·V_s. The module's example: 6 kg, 0.6 m², 1.2 → V_s = 11.6 m/s, `AIRSPEED_MIN` ≥ 13.9 m/s. Lower than that means a stall right after "Transition done".

tasks.title: Hover shaft power
tasks.statement: A QuadPlane with a mass of **{m} kg** hovers on four propellers of diameter **{d} m**, with a propeller figure of merit FM = **{fm}**, ρ = 1.225 kg/m³. Find the total shaft power of the lift propellers, in W.
tasks.solution: A = 4·π·D²/4, P = (m·g)^1.5 / (FM·√(2·ρ·A)). The module's example: 6 kg, 0.381 m, 0.6 → A = 0.456 m², 427 W of ideal power, 712 W at the shaft.

tasks.title: How many times more hover costs than cruise
tasks.statement: An aircraft: **{m} kg**, four lift propellers with D = 0.381 m, FM = 0.6, ρ = 1.225 kg/m³. Cruise at **{v} m/s**, lift-to-drag ratio L/D = **{ld}**, cruise propeller efficiency 0.6. Find the ratio of hover power to cruise power (both at the shaft).
tasks.solution: P_hov = (m·g)^1.5/(FM·√(2ρA)), P_cr = m·g·V/((L/D)·η_p); the ratio grows as √m for the same propeller area. The module's example: 6 kg, 20 m/s, L/D = 10 → 712 / 196 = 3.6.
